title: 第7章 寡妇上门第8章 初次治疗
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
夜幕悄然降临。
赵大柱盘坐在床上运功打坐，道道热流在他的身体里不断流淌。
这使得他浑身发热，经脉胀痛，腹部也传来一阵痛感。
但是赵大柱并没有停下来，反而还加大力度，更卖力的修炼。
因为按照青灵玄生功这门功法当中的记载，经脉和腹部胀痛其实就是打通经脉和开辟丹田的征兆。
等到打通全身经脉，成功开辟丹田，他就能成为一名真正的修炼者，踏入修炼者的第一个境界——筑基期！
而且经过今天好几个小时的修炼，赵大柱明显感觉到身体里的青灵玄生真气比昨天更为雄浑。
按照这个速度判断，大概再过一个月左右，应该就能摸到筑基期的门槛！
想到这儿，赵大柱不由得有些激动，还有些期待。
忽然，王彩霞的声音从院子里传来：“赵老头你在家不？我……我不小心晚饭做多了，给你送点。”
赵大柱立刻停止修炼，下了床就把王彩霞从院子里领进来。
只见王彩霞的手里端着一个枣红色的实木托盘，托盘里放着一大碗米饭和两盘小菜。
虽然只是一盘凉拌黄瓜和一盘土豆丝炒辣椒，连一点肉沫子都看不见，可赵大柱还是高兴的不得了。
人家能给自己送饭就已经很不错了，哪还能挑挑拣拣？
赵大柱热情的请王彩霞坐下，并帮她把托盘放在桌上，随后就笑呵呵的说道：“说什么不小心做多了，我看你是专门给我准备的这两盘菜吧？”
王彩霞圆润美艳的脸颊顿时就飞起一片红霞，而且还羞答答的把头低了下去。
“你……你今天帮了我那么大的忙，不仅给我交了修路的钱还把欺负我的那帮人狠狠教训了一顿，我……我当然得有所表示。”王彩霞扭扭捏捏的说道。
“好，你有心了。”
赵大柱笑道，一屁股坐在椅子上，便拿起筷子开吃。
王彩霞并没有动筷子，只是好奇的看着赵大柱。

赵大柱于是问道：“你怎么不吃？话说你这米饭怎么只准备了一碗，你的那份呢？”
“我不吃，我刚刚已经吃过了。”王彩霞搓着手说道。
“你多少吃点，光我一个人吃，多尴尬。”赵大柱催促道。
王彩霞这才终于拿起筷子，象征性的吃了两口。
也许是实在按捺不住内心的好奇了，王彩霞小心翼翼的问道：“赵老头，你……你怎么突然变得这么厉害？你都五十多了，那帮二三十岁的壮小伙居然还打不过你？”
“我一直面朝黄土背朝天的，当然就练出了一把子力气。”赵大柱笑道。
“你这话说的真有意思，咱们村里的人哪个不是面朝黄土背朝天，可像你这么厉害的还有第二个吗？”王彩霞一脸狐疑的说道。
“你就别瞎打听了，有些事情不方便和你说。”赵大柱说道。
王彩霞见赵大柱不肯说，于是就没有再在这个话题上继续下去。
content_en:
Night falls quietly.
Zhao Dazhu sat cross-legged on the bed and meditated, with hot currents flowing through his body.
This made him feel hot all over, his meridians were swollen and painful, and he also felt a pain in his abdomen.
But Zhao Dazhu did not stop. Instead, he increased his efforts and practiced harder.
Because according to the records of Qing Ling Xuan Sheng Gong, distension and pain in the meridians and abdomen are actually signs of opening up the meridians and opening up the Dantian.
When the meridians throughout the body are opened and the Dantian is successfully opened, he can become a true cultivator and enter the first realm of a cultivator - the foundation building stage!
And after several hours of practice today, Zhao Dazhu clearly felt that the Qinglingxuansheng Qi in his body was more powerful than yesterday.
Judging from this speed, in about a month or so, we should be able to touch the threshold of the foundation building period!
Thinking of this, Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but feel a little excited and a little expectant.
Suddenly, Wang Caixia's voice came from the yard: "Old Zhao, are you at home? I...I accidentally made too much dinner, so I'll give you some."
Zhao Dazhu immediately stopped practicing, got out of bed, and brought Wang Caixia in from the yard.
I saw Wang Caixia holding a maroon solid wood tray in her hand. There was a large bowl of rice and two plates of side dishes on the tray.
Although it was just a plate of cold cucumbers and a plate of shredded potatoes and fried peppers, with not even a bit of meat foam visible, Zhao Dazhu was still very happy.
It’s already great if someone can deliver food to you, so how can you be picky?
Zhao Dazhu enthusiastically asked Wang Caixia to sit down and helped her put the tray on the table. Then he said with a smile: "You said you accidentally cooked too much? I think you prepared these two dishes specially for me?"
Wang Caixia's round and beautiful cheeks suddenly turned red, and she lowered her head shyly.
"You... you helped me so much today. Not only did you pay me the money to build the road, but you also taught the people who bullied me a lesson. I... of course I have to show something." Wang Caixia said coyly.
"Okay, you're interested."
Zhao Dazhu smiled, sat down on the chair, picked up his chopsticks and started eating.
Wang Caixia didn't move her chopsticks, but looked at Zhao Dazhu curiously.
Zhao Dazhu then asked: "Why don't you eat? By the way, why did you only prepare one bowl of rice? What's your share?"
"I won't eat, I've already eaten just now." Wang Caixia said while rubbing her hands.
"You can eat as much as you want. How embarrassing it would be for me to eat alone." Zhao Dazhu urged.
Wang Caixia finally picked up the chopsticks and took two symbolic bites.
Perhaps because she could no longer suppress her inner curiosity, Wang Caixia asked cautiously: "Old man Zhao, you...how did you suddenly become so powerful? You are over fifty, and those strong guys in their twenties and thirties still can't beat you?"
"I have been facing the loess with my back to the sky, so of course I have gained a lot of strength." Zhao Dazhu said with a smile.
"What you said is really interesting. There is no one in our village who is facing the loess and back to the sky, but is there anyone as powerful as you?" Wang Caixia said with a suspicious look on her face.
"Stop asking around, there are some things that are not convenient for me to tell you." Zhao Dazhu said.
Wang Caixia saw that Zhao Dazhu refused to talk, so she stopped continuing on this topic.
